title: Multifield dark energy: Interplay between curved field space and curved spacetime
summary: Exponential quintessence models motivated by string compactifications naturally involve both a dilatonic scalar and its axionic partner evolving on a curved field space, while spatial curvature enlarges the cosmological phase space and may affect late-time dynamics. We perform a systematic analysis of the minimal two-field exponential system in a curved FLRW background including radiation and matter components, combining a complete dynamical systems classification with analytical approximations and numerical integration.
